test_policy.notes: Fully test-optional; no preference given either way. SAT and ACT are superscored; self-reported scores accepted. Not required for non-US applicants attending high school outside the US. On the arts-school FAQ SMU says academic merit scholarship consideration for arts applicants requires submitting scores (recommended 1380 SAT or 29 ACT).

requirements.notes: Counselor recommendation required; teacher recommendation optional; extracurricular resume requested; essay generally 250-650 words. Also accepts ApplyTexas and the SMU online application. Art, film (BFA), dance, music and theatre applicants need an audition or portfolio (dual admission with Meadows). Need-based aid (US citizens/permanent residents only) uses the CSS Profile (code 6660) plus FAFSA.

deadlines.label: Early Action
deadlines.notes: Non-binding. Also the scholarship consideration deadline.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I
deadlines.notes: Binding. Notified by mail in mid-December (no exact date); deposit within two weeks of admission.

deadlines.label: Early Decision II
deadlines.notes: Binding. Notified by mail by March 1.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Non-binding. Also the scholarship consideration deadline.

deadlines.label: FAFSA priority deadline
deadlines.notes: Priority deadline for all applicants (US citizens and permanent residents).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Not required for students who attended a high school with an English-based curriculum, or who have SAT critical reading and writing 580+ or ACT writing 25+. Applicants below the recommended minimums may get conditional offers (retake or Intensive English Program).

english.notes: The FAQ labels this line 'ACT' but gives bands (reading/listening/writing/speaking 6.5), which is the IELTS scale.

aid.notes: All applicants regardless of citizenship are automatically considered for academic merit scholarships (no separate application). Need-based financial aid is available only for US citizens and permanent residents.
